\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}

\begin{zed}
  maxCount == 2
\end{zed}

\begin{schema}{Probe}
  count : \nat
\where
  count \leq maxCount
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{InitProbe}
  Probe'
\where
  count' = 0
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Step}
  \Delta Probe
\where
  count < maxCount \\
  count' = count + 1
\end{schema}

\end{document}
